pair_decision: T14 counts as the tenth pilot matched pair: both frozen host grades passed fresh offline wheel build/install, all 60/61 project tests, and all five semantic checks. The v1 candidate workflow is incomplete because its required test-review gate failed after three attempts; the v2 final code and security reviews passed. Record these as distinct workflow and host-acceptance outcomes.

baseline_calibration.note: Baseline wheel build, offline install, and all 58 existing tests pass. The frozen semantic grader passes nonzero/non-JSON visibility, timeout cleanup, and literal argv; it fails cancellation cleanup because the child is left running. The grader returns nonzero for any failed semantic criterion.

first_pass_outcomes.v1: Final candidate code passed the suite and host behavior checks, but the test-review workflow gate did not approve deterministic reap-timing evidence within three attempts.
first_pass_outcomes.v2: The first reviewed implementation exposed an inherited-pipe cleanup edge case; the final implementation added cleanup and regression coverage, after which both reviews and host acceptance passed.

protocol_limitations: The interactive Codex TUI parent ran on the host; harness-eval applied to tool children only, so this was not a VM-isolated TUI run.
